title: Grateful Dead Live at JFK Stadium on 1989-07-07
lineage: CDs extracted with Max 0.7.1 using CD paranoia setting; compressed using XACT 1.6.2 FLAC level 5
source: AKG414 FOB (probably from Dan Tepper's rig - AKG414TL > AKG B18 power supplies > Technics SV-MD1)

ai_review.summary: A top‑tier summer ’89 show highlighted by a superb Iko performance, captured on a bass‑heavy front‑of‑house mix that’s solid though a bit low‑level.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this concert as one of the best shows of 1989, singling out the unforgettable Iko rendition. The recording is praised for its deep bottom end and overall quality, despite slightly low levels and reduced midrange punch compared to other masters.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are enthusiastic; the show is described as top‑tier while the recording is good but not flawless, yielding an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: More bottom end than the Clugston remaster, slightly less midrange punch, and levels set a tad low; nevertheless both reviewers consider it very good.
